flags.person: Allan Kauffman, Mario Garber, José Elizalde, Roger Nafziger (board members, not on the ballot)
flags.summary: In February 2024, board members Allan Kauffman, Mario Garber, José Elizalde and Roger Nafziger and former candidate Andrea Johnson were charged over campaign finance reports for a 2022 school board mailer.
flags.note: A later WVPE report (source not retained) said Elizalde and Nafziger pleaded guilty to a Level 6 felony; other outcomes unconfirmed. None of these members is on the 2026 ballot.

sources.title: Four Goshen School Board members criminally charged with campaign finance violations
